description: Seeded cooling crystallization of caffeine from water, four runs, 2 x 2 in seed load and final cooling rate (Nagy group, Purdue, October and November 2026).

charge.basis: Targets from the lab's recipe sheet. The load is the saturation amount at 40 C from Shalmashi and Golmohammad 2010, Table 1 (mole fraction 4.367e-3 at 313 K). The yield is that load minus 5.1169 g, the sheet's estimate of what stays dissolved at 20 C. Weighed masses were not reported. The lab reuses the batch from one run to the next and adjusts it in between; the adjustments are not recorded here, so these targets describe a fresh batch and the charge of a later run may differ.

seeding.basis: Seed mass is a percentage of the theoretical yield. The seed was slurried in liquid taken from the vessel and returned during the hold at 37 C, so the water mass does not change. Seed size was not measured.

temperature_program: 20 C for 30 min, heat to 45 C in 50 min, hold 30 min, cool to 37 C in 16 min, hold 30 min, cool to 20 C at the final ramp rate, hold.

temperature_log.basis: The log has one row every 2 s. Reduced temperatures are means of 15 consecutive rows (30 s). The fastest ramp is 0.5 C/min, so a block spans at most 0.25 C, and the mean of a linear ramp equals its value at the mean time.

fbrm.basis: Measurement interval set in iC FBRM. The count bands are the ones the vendor software reports, split at exactly 10 and 100 um.

ir_band.solvent_basis: The absorbance at the water bending band is written beside the band height as a contact check. It reads 0.86 to 0.99 during the temperature program of the three runs with the probe immersed.
ir_band.basis: A band that grows when the caffeine dissolves, taken to be a caffeine carbonyl stretch (assignment not checked against a reference spectrum). Both baseline anchors are on the high-wavenumber side because the water bending band near 1640 cm-1 occupies the other side. Water alone reads 0.065 with this definition, so the calibration must carry an intercept.

band_calibration.basis: Windows on the run clock. Solvent: the spectra of the reference run taken before the caffeine was added, the only water-only spectra of the dataset. Dissolved: the second half of the 45 C hold, and the 37 C hold from 440 s after the end of the cooling step to before the earliest seeding spike (8618 s). Slurry start: the 20 C hold after the hydrate has formed (complete by 700 s in the reference run). Slurry end: the last 30 minutes of spectra. The reference temperature is the seeding hold, 37 C. high_seed_fast_cool is left out: its probe was not in proper contact with the liquid.

solubility.basis: Window on the run clock: from the 20 C hold, once the hydrate has formed, through the heating ramp to 45 C. A spectrum counts as taken with solid present while the total FBRM counts are at least 100, the limit used for the clear point; the clear solution reads below 60 counts. Dissolution lags the heating of about 0.5 C/min, so the points are a lower bound of the solubility.

properties.basis: Property database of caffeine and water for the crystallizer models. Each species entry states the source of every value.

solid.basis: The solid is counted as caffeine: the density is the caffeine in a unit volume of hydrate crystal (rho_solid of compounds.json). The shape factor is pi/6 exactly, because the characteristic length is defined as the diameter of the sphere with the volume of the crystal. Sizes of the model are therefore volume-equivalent diameters, not needle lengths.

simulation.seed_size_basis: Assumption; no seed size was measured. The seed is taken as crystals of one size, the geometric mean of 10 and 100 um, the chord band that holds about two thirds of the FBRM counts at the seeding spike (625 of 963, 225 of 346, 363 of 501 and 628 of 944 in the four runs). To be scanned between 10 and 150 um when the kinetics are fitted.

kinetics_starting_values.basis: Starting values for a fit, not results. Growth: rate constant [um/s], activation energy [J/mol], order [-]. Secondary nucleation: rate constant [#/m3/s], activation energy [J/mol], order in supersaturation [-], order in solid volume fraction [-]. Of twelve order-of-magnitude combinations tried on high_seed_slow_cool, this one gave the time scale of the measured desupersaturation (root-mean-square difference 0.0023 kg/kg in the dissolved caffeine per water). The activation energies are zero and the last order is one by the choices of the case-selection note.

simulation.basis: The model starts at the seeding time of each run, with the measured external temperature as a prescribed control.

seeding_basis: seeding_time_s of each run is the time on the run clock of the FBRM sample with the most counts during the hold at 37 C: the spike of the seed addition. No process note records the addition.
clock_basis: The temperature log has relative time only. Its start relative to the first FBRM sample interval is estimated from file modification times; treat it as good to about one minute. FBRM stamps are local time of the acquisition computer; IR and Raman stamps are UTC.

20261108 Caffeine JLR High Seed Fast Cool
runs.notes: The iC IR file was never finalized; its spectra are recovered by block scan. The IR probe was not in proper contact with the liquid for most of the run: the absorbance at the water band stays below 0.8, against 0.86 to 0.99 in the other runs, until 23,900 s on the run clock, long after the crystallization. The band height is not a concentration signal before that. Fine FBRM counts of unknown cause appear early in the 45 C hold, before seeding.
